summary: Steel lookout built 1937 at the Georgia Forestry Commission office in Thomasville; the register says it currently houses radio repeater equipment, though its notes are undated.

facts.design: Register says it appears to be an Aermotor LS-40 or MC-39 (uncertain); 90 feet high with a 7-by-7-by-10-foot steel cab

events.note: Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on March 27, 2014

evidence.supports: located at the Georgia Forestry Commission office at Thomasville

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 294 ft (90 m); the tnlandforms list gives 282 with no unit stated and the same coordinates. The story uses the register figure. The record's elevation_m of 89.6 matches the register.

notes_for_editor: Register is the only detailed source; its condition and staffing notes are undated. Build year 1937 comes from the register's build field alone. The Aermotor model is stated by the register as uncertain. Two WebSearch queries and one websearch.py query found nothing on a Thomasville GA tower; Chenocetah Fire Tower results (Habersham County) are a different tower and were not used. Access and as-of date for staffing left unknown.
